newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's president to visit Jordan next week.
newsitem.headline: Israel's president to visit Jordan next week.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman plans to visit Amman on November 6 for talks with Jordan's King Hussein, an Israeli official said on Wednesday.
Weizman, who has used his largely ceremonial office as a platform for urging Israel's right-wing government to pursue peace, visited Cairo two weeks ago on a goodwill mission.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said Weizman was likely to spend several hours in the Jordanian capital.
The president's office said it had no official announcement about a visit yet.
Earlier this month, Weizman hosted Palestinian President Yasser Arafat at his private residence in the seaside town of Caesarea. It was Arafat's first public visit to the Jewish state.
Israel and the Palestinians are currently locked in negotiations on implementing a long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.
Jordan and Israel signed a peace treaty in 1994 but relations have been strained since Benjamin Netanyahu was elected prime minister in May vowing to hold on to occupied Arab territory.
